proposition_vocabulary.P_CLINICAL_OCCURRENCE: R611Q was observed in a reported person, family, cohort, or tumor.
proposition_vocabulary.P_CLIPE_SCORE: R611Q has an allele-specific cliPE CMAS observation.
proposition_vocabulary.P_COMPLEX_BINDING: R611Q reduces TSC1 binding or TSC-complex formation/associated TSC1 abundance.
proposition_vocabulary.P_COMPOUND_RESCUE: A compound directly binds and stabilizes/rescues R611Q TSC2.
proposition_vocabulary.P_CONTROL_REUSE: R611Q was reused as a known inactive/pathogenic comparator rather than generated as a new study allele.
proposition_vocabulary.P_DEFINED_DEGRON: R611Q creates or exposes a defined degron.
proposition_vocabulary.P_DRUGGABLE_POCKET: R611Q has a validated ligandable/druggable pocket or defined Arg611-TSC1 contact.
proposition_vocabulary.P_EVEROLIMUS_DOWNSTREAM: Rapalog treatment suppresses downstream mTORC1 readouts in an R611Q-containing context.
proposition_vocabulary.P_G1_CELL_CYCLE: Mutant TSC2 including R611Q was evaluated for a G1 cell-cycle effect.
proposition_vocabulary.P_GENERAL_GAP_MECHANISM: General TSC-complex structure/biochemistry shows TSC1-dependent allosteric support of GAP activity.
proposition_vocabulary.P_GENERAL_PROTEOSTASIS: General TSC1/Hsp90/HERC1 proteostasis mechanisms can regulate TSC2 handling.
proposition_vocabulary.P_INTRINSIC_GAP_RESCUE: R611Q retains intrinsic Rheb-GAP activity after abundance and complex formation are restored.
proposition_vocabulary.P_MISFOLDING: R611Q directly misfolds, aggregates, or exposes hydrophobic surface.
proposition_vocabulary.P_MTORC1_SUPPRESSION: R611Q impairs TSC-complex-dependent suppression of mTORC1/TORC1 readouts.
proposition_vocabulary.P_PAM_UBIQUITINATION: R611Q remains susceptible to Pam/MYCBP2-associated ubiquitination despite TSC1 co-expression.
proposition_vocabulary.P_RAC1_ROS_MOTILITY: R611Q expression altered Rac1/ROS/cell-motility readouts in the reported system.
proposition_vocabulary.P_RAPAMYCIN_MIRNA: Rapamycin altered miRNA/pS6 readouts in the R611Q-plus-LOH 621 lineage.
proposition_vocabulary.P_STEADY_STATE_ABUNDANCE: R611Q lowers steady-state TSC2 abundance in the stated assay.
proposition_vocabulary.P_STRUCTURE_COVERAGE: Wild-type experimental TSC2 structures model residue 611.
proposition_vocabulary.P_TUMOR_TWO_HIT: R611Q occurred with loss/inactivation of the other TSC2 allele in the reported tumor context.
proposition_vocabulary.P_TURNOVER_PROTEASOME: R611Q has a measured shortened half-life or demonstrated proteasome-dependent turnover.
proposition_vocabulary.P_VAMP_ABUNDANCE: R611Q has an allele-specific VAMP-seq abundance observation.
